name: newzic-app
description: Newzic mobile app - wraps newzic-fe via Capacitor

scripts.build:fe: cd ../newzic-fe && ng build --configuration=production && rm -rf ../newzic-app/www && cp -r dist/newzic/browser ../newzic-app/www
scripts.sync: npm run build:fe && npx cap sync
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:fe && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:fe && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run build:fe && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios --target $(xcrun simctl list devices available | grep 'iPhone' | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9A-F]{8}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{12}')
scripts.android: npm run build:fe && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
